# Introduction

MoSAR cohort validation for treatment response biomarkers identified from the
SATVI cohort. Paired Wilcoxon tests compare cytokine concentrations between
baseline (Visit 0) and end of treatment (Visit 24). Due to small sample size
(12 paired TB patients before and after treatment), fold change instead of p value
is reported. AUC-ROC of the identified biomarkers is also reported at the end.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(pROC)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_file <- "Input/MoSAR_treatment_response_20251222_Luminex_TruC.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/Figure_S5A"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Define metadata and cytokine columns

```{r}
#| label: define-columns

id_col   <- "Subject_ID"
meta_cols <- c(id_col, "Visit")

# cytokine columns defined by range LPS_IL_1RA to Null_CCL2
lps_idx  <- which(names(all_data) == "LPS_IL_1RA")
ccl2_idx <- which(names(all_data) == "Null_CCL2")

cytokine_cols <- names(all_data)[lps_idx:ccl2_idx]
cytokine_cols <- setdiff(cytokine_cols, meta_cols)

cat(sprintf("Metadata columns : %s\n", paste(meta_cols, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Cytokine columns : %d\n", length(cytokine_cols)))
cat(sprintf("First 5          : %s\n", paste(head(cytokine_cols, 5), collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Last 5           : %s\n", paste(tail(cytokine_cols, 5), collapse = ", ")))
```

# Recode Visit and check data

```{r}
#| label: recode-visit

all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Visit   = as.numeric(Visit),
    Subject_ID = as.character(Subject_ID)
  )

cat("Visits present:", paste(sort(unique(all_data$Visit)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Subjects      :", n_distinct(all_data$Subject_ID), "\n")
cat("Total rows    :", nrow(all_data), "\n")
```

# Log10 transform cytokine values

```{r}
#| label: log-transform

protein_data_log <- all_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokine_cols), ~ log10(.x)))

head(protein_data_log[, c(meta_cols, head(cytokine_cols, 3))])
```

# Paired analysis function

```{r}
#| label: analysis-function

analyze_cytokines_paired <- function(data, cytokine_cols,
                                     visit_0     = 0,
                                     visit_24    = 24,
                                     save_path   = NULL,
                                     plot_width  = 3.5,
                                     plot_height = 5) {

  results <- list()

  for (cyt in cytokine_cols) {

    tryCatch({

      # Subset to Visit 0 and Visit 24
      v0_data <- data %>%
        filter(Visit == visit_0) %>%
        arrange(Subject_ID) %>%
        select(Subject_ID, value_v0 = all_of(cyt))

      v24_data <- data %>%
        filter(Visit == visit_24) %>%
        arrange(Subject_ID) %>%
        select(Subject_ID, value_v24 = all_of(cyt))

      # Paired join
      paired_data <- inner_join(v0_data, v24_data, by = "Subject_ID") %>%
        drop_na(value_v0, value_v24)

      if (nrow(paired_data) < 3) {
        message(sprintf("%s: insufficient pairs (n = %d) : skipping.", cyt, nrow(paired_data)))
        next
      }

      paired_data <- paired_data %>%
        mutate(
          log10_fc    = value_v24 - value_v0,   
          fold_change = 10^log10_fc               
        )

      median_log10_fc <- median(paired_data$log10_fc,    na.rm = TRUE)
      median_fc       <- median(paired_data$fold_change, na.rm = TRUE)

      # Reshape to long format for ggplot
      plot_data <- paired_data %>%
        select(Subject_ID, value_v0, value_v24) %>%
        pivot_longer(
          cols      = c(value_v0, value_v24),
          names_to  = "Visit_label",
          values_to = "log10_conc"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Visit_label = factor(
            ifelse(Visit_label == "value_v0", "V0", "V24"),
            levels = c("V0", "V24")
          )
        )

      # Y-axis annotation position
      y_max   <- max(plot_data$log10_conc, na.rm = TRUE)
      y_min   <- min(plot_data$log10_conc, na.rm = TRUE)
      y_range <- y_max - y_min
      annot_y <- y_max + y_range * 0.12
      text_y  <- y_max + y_range * 0.25

      p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Visit_label, y = log10_conc)) +
        geom_boxplot(
          outlier.shape = NA,
          alpha         = 0.5,
          width         = 0.5,
          fill          = "white"
        ) +
        geom_line(
          aes(group = Subject_ID),
          color     = "grey60",
          linewidth = 0.3,
          alpha     = 0.6
        ) +
        geom_point(
          aes(group = Subject_ID),
          size  = 2,
          alpha = 0.8,
          color = "black"
        ) +
        annotate(
          "segment",
          x = 1, xend = 2,
          y = annot_y, yend = annot_y,
          color = "black"
        ) +
        annotate(
          "text",
          x        = 1.5,
          y        = text_y,
          label = sprintf("Median FC = %.2f", median_fc),
          size     = 3.5,
          fontface = "bold",
          color = "black"
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.35))
        ) +
        labs(
          title    = paste0(cyt, " | MoSAR"),
          subtitle = sprintf("n = %d paired patients", nrow(paired_data)),
          x        = "Visit",
          y        = "Concentration (log10 pg/mL)"
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
          axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
          axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
          plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40"),
          legend.position  = "none"
        )

      print(p)

      # Print summary
      cat(sprintf("\n%s\n", cyt))
      cat(sprintf("  Pairs                    : %d\n",   nrow(paired_data)))
      cat(sprintf("  Median log10 V0          : %.3f\n", median(paired_data$value_v0,   na.rm = TRUE)))
      cat(sprintf("  Median log10 V24         : %.3f\n", median(paired_data$value_v24,  na.rm = TRUE)))
      cat(sprintf("  Median log10 FC          : %.3f\n", median_log10_fc))
      cat(sprintf("  Median Fold Change       : %.3f\n", median_fc))
      cat(sprintf("  Increased (FC > 1)       : %.1f%%\n", 100 * mean(paired_data$fold_change > 1)))
      cat(sprintf("  Decreased (FC < 1)       : %.1f%%\n", 100 * mean(paired_data$fold_change < 1)))

      # Save plot
      if (!is.null(save_path)) {
        ggsave(
          filename = file.path(save_path, paste0(cyt, "_paired_V0_V24.png")),
          plot     = p,
          width    = plot_width,
          height   = plot_height,
          dpi      = 300
        )
      }

      results[[cyt]] <- data.frame(
        cytokine        = cyt,
        n_pairs         = nrow(paired_data),
        median_log10_v0 = median(paired_data$value_v0,   na.rm = TRUE),
        median_log10_v24= median(paired_data$value_v24,  na.rm = TRUE),
        median_log10_fc = median_log10_fc,
        median_fc       = median_fc,
        pct_increased   = 100 * mean(paired_data$fold_change > 1),
        pct_decreased   = 100 * mean(paired_data$fold_change < 1)
      )

    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Error processing %s: %s", cyt, e$message))
    })
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}
```

# Run paired analysis

```{r}
#| label: run-analysis
#| fig-width: 3.5
#| fig-height: 5
#| message: true
#| warning: false

results_df <- analyze_cytokines_paired(
  data         = protein_data_log,
  cytokine_cols = cytokine_cols,
  visit_0      = 0,
  visit_24     = 24,
  save_path    = output_main,
  plot_width   = 3.5,
  plot_height  = 5
)

cat(sprintf("\nTotal cytokines analysed: %d\n", nrow(results_df)))
```

# Save summary results

```{r}
#| label: save-results

results_df <- results_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(median_log10_fc)))   # rank by magnitude of fold change

write_xlsx(
  results_df,
  path = file.path(output_main, "Figure_S5A_fold_change_results.xlsx")
)

cat("Top 10 cytokines by fold change magnitude:\n")
print(head(results_df, 10))
cat("\nResults saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```

# AUC-ROC of the dramatically changed biomarkers

```{r}
#| label: AUC-ROC
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10
#| message: true
#| warning: false
# Define stimulus-cytokine combinations for ROC testings
cytokine_names <- c("Null_IL_18", "Null_IL_1RA", "Null_CCL3", "LPS_CCL2", "LPS_IFNG", "Null_IFNG", "LPS_IL_1RA")

# Function to create ROC analysis for biomarkers
create_roc <- function(data, cytokine) {
  tryCatch({

    if (!cytokine %in% names(data)) {
      message("Column ", cytokine, " not found in data")
      return(NULL)
    }

    valid_data <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[cytokine]]))
    
# Visit 0 = pre-treatment, Visit 24 = post-treatment
    roc_obj <- roc(valid_data$Visit, valid_data[[cytokine]],
                   levels    = c(0, 24),    
                   direction = "auto")         

    return(list(
      roc = roc_obj,
      auc = auc(roc_obj)
    ))

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error creating ROC for ", cytokine, ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Create ROC objects for each cytokine
roc_list <- list()
for (cytokine in cytokine_names) {
  roc_result <- create_roc(protein_data_log, cytokine)
  if (!is.null(roc_result)) {
    roc_list[[cytokine]] <- roc_result
  }
}

if (length(roc_list) == 0) {
  stop("No valid ROC objects could be created. Check your data and cytokine names.")
}
cat("Created", length(roc_list), "ROC curves\n")

# Compute AUC + 95% CI per cytokine
auc_df <- imap_dfr(roc_list, function(roc_result, cyt) {

  ci_vals <- ci.auc(roc_result$roc) 
  auc_val <- as.numeric(roc_result$auc)
  ci_low  <- as.numeric(ci_vals[1])
  ci_high <- as.numeric(ci_vals[3])

  data.frame(
    cytokine = cyt,
    auc      = auc_val,
    ci_low   = ci_low,
    ci_high  = ci_high,
    label    = sprintf("%s (AUC = %.2f, 95%% CI: %.2f-%.2f)",
                       cyt, auc_val, ci_low, ci_high)
  )
})

cat("\nAUC Summary:\n")
print(auc_df[, c("cytokine", "auc", "ci_low", "ci_high")])

# Build ROC curve
roc_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(roc_list), function(cyt) {

    roc_result <- roc_list[[cyt]]

    data.frame(
      one_minus_spec = 1 - roc_result$roc$specificities,
      sensitivity    = roc_result$roc$sensitivities,
      cytokine       = cyt
    ) %>%
      arrange(one_minus_spec, sensitivity)   
  })
) %>%
  left_join(auc_df %>% select(cytokine, label),
            by = "cytokine") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = auc_df$label))      

colors <- c("red", "magenta", "#CC6600", "#009966", "blue", "#9933FF", "black")

color_map <- setNames(
  colors[seq_along(auc_df$cytokine)],
  auc_df$label
)

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df,
                aes(x     = one_minus_spec,
                    y     = sensitivity,
                    color = label)) +

  # Reference diagonal
  geom_abline(slope     = 1,
              intercept = 0,
              linetype  = "dashed",
              color     = "grey60",
              linewidth = 0.6) +

  # ROC curves
  geom_step(linewidth = 1.1,
            alpha     = 0.9,
            direction = "hv") +      

  scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +

  labs(
    title = "ROC Curves: Visit 0 vs Visit 24 (MoSAR)",  
    x     = "1 - Specificity",
    y     = "Sensitivity",
    color = NULL                                        
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2))

p_roc

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_main, "MoSAR_Treatment_TB_ROC_curves.png"),
  plot     = p_roc,
  width    = 6,
  height   = 8,
  dpi      = 300
)

cat("ROC plot saved to:", output_main, "\n")
cat("\nAUC Values (95% CI):\n")
cat(strrep("-", 55), "\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(auc_df))) {
  cat(sprintf("%-20s AUC = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f-%.3f)\n",
              auc_df$cytokine[i],
              auc_df$auc[i],
              auc_df$ci_low[i],
              auc_df$ci_high[i]))
}
```
